title: On the ranks of string C-group representations for symplectic and orthogonal groups
status_note: PSp(4,q) has spectrum {3,4,5} except q=3, where it has none; a table of constructions should not be mistaken for a universal upper bound in higher dimension.

title: String C-group representations of transitive groups: a case study with degree 11
status_note: Calls A11 the unique known finite simple group with a noninterval rank spectrum.

title: On the rank of Suzuki polytopes: an answer to Hubard and Leemans
status_note: Resolves the conjecture that Suzuki chiral polytopes have rank three.

title: Abstract regular polytopes of G2(q) in even characteristic
status_note: Submitted September 21, 2026. Questions 4.1/4.2 ask for upper ranks in even/odd characteristic; all ranks 3,4,5 are constructed when q>2 is even.

title: Polytopality criteria for the mix of polytopes and maniplexes
status_note: Three final problems concern admissible covers, preserving two-orbit class under mixing, and smallest regular covers.

title: Abstract Regular Polytopes of Finite Irreducible Coxeter Groups
status_note: Determines rank ranges for Coxeter groups; do not transfer bounds to simple quotients without proof.

title: Faithfulness in maniplexes
status_note: Version of record, Journal of Algebraic Combinatorics 64(2), article23, September2026. Its three open problems concern two-facet faithfulness, polytopes arising as posets of unfaithful maniplexes, and reconstructing a thin flagged poset.

title: On solutions to the Mondrian Puzzle
status_note: Dated August28,2026. Proves positive lower density of impossible side lengths, while explicitly retaining nonexistence of any Mondrian integer as Conjecture1.1.

title: On the order-diameter ratio of girth-diameter cages
status_note: Version3 August19,2026; DMTCS28:4. Settles107 parameter triples, retains even-girth bipartiteness Question1. Its table does not settle (7;5,4).

title: Every finite group is represented by a finite incidence geometry
status_note: Version2 December16,2025. Every finite pair H normal in G is realized as (correlations,type-preserving automorphisms) of a finite incidence geometry.

title: Explicit constructions of Diophantine tuples over finite fields
status_note: Primary published formulation of the exact multiplicative Weil bound used in the team's candidate proof of Conjecture6.1; cites Lidl-Niederreiter Theorem5.41.

title: Exhaustive generation of edge-girth-regular graphs
status_note: Section4 disproves Araujo-Pardo–Leemans extremality conjecture (arXiv Conj4.6; published Conj4.4): n(3,8,8)=40<54; n(3,12,32)<=162<486. Its own Conjecture2 concerns four nonexistence parameters.

title: String C-groups of 2-power order project onto a common string C-group
status_note: Every finite regular d-polytope with 2-power automorphism group covers Conder's common minimal polytope. This does not classify all such polytopes.

title: Regular 3-polytopes of type {n,n}
status_note: Theorem1.3/Corollary3.6 resolves the Type(2) question of Hou–Feng–Leemans2025. Conjecture3.7 proposes higher-rank Coxeter quotients with specified local relations. Only preprintv1 located through cutoff.

title: Infinite Families of Hypertopes from Centrally Symmetric Polytopes
status_note: Extends centrally symmetric polytopes and applies halving to construct infinite locally spherical/toroidal hypertope families. Does not state a resolution of the universal square-diagram conjectures in L003. No explicit new open problem found by full-text search.

title: Symmetric polytopes whose automorphism groups are 2-groups
status_note: Constructs regular and alternating semiregular polytopes with prescribed rank3 sections, and proves universal extension preserves having a2-group. Does not claim a full classification or resolve L034 Conjecture3.3.

title: LCD codes from adjacency matrices of graphs
status_note: Proposition1(2) proves graph-complement code duality implies LCD for regular graphs, a direct followup to L050. This precedes the team's elementary general matrix observation; do not advertise the regular-graph result as new.
